summary: Prime Minister expressed grief over the loss of lives in an accident in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, and attended the 5th Skill Convocation Ceremony in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the NDRF 12th Battalion campus in Itanagar and unveiled the 'Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047'.
According to a World Bank report, Modi government policies have helped 49.60 crore people escape the poverty line so far.

The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) featured various events including 'Films from BRICS', discussions on the role of film schools, and projects like 'Ramayana: The Rise of a Legend' and 'Banaras' by Bharat Bala and A.R. Rahman.
The Lok Sabha Speaker called for a mass movement to keep the Yamuna river clean, and the first SCO Civilizational Dialogue Forum concluded in New Delhi.

questions.question: According to the World Bank report, how many people have been lifted out of the poverty line in the country due to the Modi government's policies?
questions.explanation: As per the World Bank report cited in PIB, Modi government policies have helped 49.60 crore people in the country move out of the poverty line.

questions.question: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the NDRF 12th Battalion campus in which city?
questions.explanation: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah inaugurated the NDRF 12th Battalion campus in Itanagar.

questions.question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the 5th Skill Convocation Ceremony in which city of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi attended the 5th Skill Convocation Ceremony in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: Which vision document was unveiled by Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah during the cooperation event in Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Union Home and Cooperation Minister Shri Amit Shah unveiled ‘Arunachal Pradesh Cooperative Vision 2047’ in Itanagar.

questions.question: At which edition of the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) did 'Films from BRICS' begin with 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' (Part 1)?
questions.explanation: At the 57th IFFI, 'Films from BRICS' was initiated with ‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’ (Part 1).

questions.question: Where did the accident occur in Tamil Nadu for which the Prime Minister expressed his condolences?
questions.explanation: The Prime Minister expressed grief over the loss of lives in an accident in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Who gave a call for a mass movement to keep the Yamuna river clean?
questions.explanation: The Lok Sabha Speaker called for a mass movement to keep Yamuna clean.

questions.question: Where was the first SCO Civilizational Dialogue Forum concluded?
questions.explanation: The first SCO Civilizational Dialogue Forum concluded in New Delhi, emphasizing shared heritage and cultural cooperation.
